subject: FinEdge demo + prep: reschedule and dry-run
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@finedge.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + demo request (sample data & prep)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the intro last week — FinEdge is excited to see Redwood in action. We'd like to schedule a demo to evaluate latency/cost against our workload and to walk through how private deployments would fit our requirements. Two asks up front so we can make the session effective:

- Can your team run a brief dry-run (internal prep) before the customer-facing demo? We have prompt sets, a small workload trace, and a sanitized sample dataset (CSV).
- Who on Redwood's side needs access to the sample data (we can provide S3-read or a secure link)?

Proposed slot for the customer-facing demo: Wed, Apr 18 at 11:00 AM ET. If that works, we'll block it on our side.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Engineering, FinEdge Analytics
liam.oconnor@finedge.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (sample data & prep)

Hi Liam — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear asks.

Quick scheduling note: I’m traveling the week of Apr 14–18 and will be in transit on the 18th, so I won’t be available for the proposed slot. Would you be open to moving the customer-facing demo to Thu, Apr 23 at 09:30 AM ET? That gives our team time to complete an internal dry-run and validation.

Marcus (Solutions Eng) — can you confirm minimal access requirements for the dry-run and whether a short internal rehearsal on Apr 22 would be doable?
Evelyn (PM) — we’ll want to run through the prompt set and one workload trace; can you own the quality checklist and quick evals?

If FinEdge can provide:
- a sanitized sample-schema.csv (small, <5MB)
- a workload-trace.json (top-100 requests, anonymized)
- S3 read credentials OR a secure link to upload to the staging bucket

We’ll aim for a 45–60 minute customer demo and a separate internal 60-minute dry-run the day before. If Apr 23 09:30 ET works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite and a prep doc link.

Best,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 10:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (sample data & prep)

Thanks Neha — I can take lead on the dry-run prep. Minimal ask from our infra side:

- Sample dataset: CSV with schema and a single small file we can ingest (sample-schema.csv).
- Workload traces: top-100 request log (JSON) and a couple of long-context examples.
- Access: temporary S3 read-only credentials to a staging prefix (preferred). If customers prefer, we can accept a secure presigned URL.

I propose an internal dry-run on Wed, Apr 22 at 15:00 ET (60 minutes) to validate prompts, model selection, and access. I'll attach a short prep checklist for the team (prep-checklist.pdf).

Attaching: prep-checklist.pdf (checklist + quick validation commands)

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 16:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (sample data & prep)

Looping Jordan for any infra/secret-store notes.

I can own the prompt review and quick evals. For scope: please confirm whether FinEdge wants us to run the following during dry-run:
- end-to-end prompt replay over the top-10 traces
- token-cost estimation for the main prompt shapes
- a short regression test comparing two model configs (latency vs quantization)

If yes, I recommend we set the dry-run to 60 minutes and reserve an extra 30 minutes next morning for a final sanity check. Marcus — can you confirm whether token-cost tooling needs a separate account or we can run against the same staging prefix?

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finedge.ai>
Cc: Olivia Zhang <olivia.zhang@finedge.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: FinEdge demo + prep: reschedule and dry-run

Hi Liam / Olivia — quick update and confirmation. Thanks for the flexibility.

- Customer-facing demo: Thu, Apr 23, 2025 at 09:30 AM ET (45–60 minutes) — I’ve tentatively blocked this on our calendars.
- Internal dry-run: Wed, Apr 22, 2025 at 03:00 PM ET (60 minutes) — Marcus and Evelyn will run the rehearsal, validate access, and check prompt behaviors.

Prep items we need from FinEdge (attach directly to this thread or upload to the Drive link below):
- sample-schema.csv (sanitized)
- workload-trace.json (anonymized)
- preferred access method: S3 prefix (preferred) or presigned upload link

Attachments: sample-schema.csv (attached), prep-checklist.pdf (Marcus attached earlier)
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-prep-plan (prep doc)
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234 (invite will be sent once you confirm)

If Apr 23 09:30 ET doesn’t work, tell me two alternate windows and we’ll pivot. Otherwise, please reply with the upload method and I’ll finalize invites.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (617) 555-0123
